rationale: Round-3 verdict on commit c9168f0, the second fix commit on top of the round-1 (7092637..dca8e9d) and round-2 (9ba4562) PASS_WITH_RISK reviews. The dimension reviewers report 267 passed on 3.11 and 3.13 in CI, 237 passed under global Python 3.13 with only tests/test_api_server.py skipped, and 267 passed under Python 3.11. The round-2 items are resolved. xbrl_bctc_auditor.py:209 now applies math.isfinite to every score, so numpy float32 and float16 scores are refused as score_not_finite with no false DISTRESS or SAFE. An int overflow is caught as score_not_finite. The 1e-310 row reaches the Beneish score_not_finite path. The ingest API rejects a padded, bool or numeric exchange with 422. There is no binding-rule violation, no order-execution or buy/sell wording, the disclaimer is unchanged, and no critical or high issue is evidenced. One confirmed medium remains. The new float32 row (tests/test_forensics_guards.py:154-156) depends on NumPy 2 promotion. Under numpy 1.26.4, which pyproject.toml declares supported (numpy>=1.26.0), 3_800_000.0 / float32(1e-40) is a finite float64, so the row fails with Z=2.28e46 SAFE. Reproduced on fresh git archive copies: HEAD 1 failed and 72 passed; 9ba4562 70 passed. The code fix is correct on both numpy versions. Fix: cast market_cap to float32 too, or raise the floor to numpy>=2.0 (owner decision). Five lows remain. (1) The exchange test pins only rejections: no-uppercase, over-reject-US and drop-empty-check mutants survive while a canary mutant is killed. (2) No test pins that a finite numpy score is still returned; an over-refuse mutant survives. (3) An int overflow inside a guard operand reports score_not_finite where the same float input reports the guard reason (prev_CA = prev_PPE = 10**308 versus 1e308), against the class docstring. (4) system-architecture.md:23 and code-standards.md:69 say a malformed SSI foreign volume raises, but a bool is read as 1.0 (docs only; the deferral is recorded). (5) code-standards.md:51 omits the score_not_finite cases. L5 (Decimal fields) and L6 (bool SSI foreign volumes) are not re-raised, because the recorded reasons hold. Only one medium (test portability) and five lows remain, so the verdict is PASS_WITH_RISK with these risks named.
